subject: Re-run CSD end-to-end and parity-check
description:
Move the already-fixed per-category _5_apply_split.py and _6_save_outputs.py into _shared_modules/ as single scripts taking --category. Ports notebook cells 62 and 64.

MOSTLY DONE ALREADY (P0036 task 15, uncommitted on disk):
  - _5 resolves cutoffs from the data via resolve_split_cutoffs(), logs them, passes them to apply_split()
  - _6 writes split_dates.json from the boundaries ACTUALLY APPLIED, read back off the labelled frame, rather than re-deriving from module constants (the old form could disagree with the real labels)
  - val_df binding was added to _6 (it only had train_df/test_df)

This task collapses 3 copies of each into 1 shared copy each, and adds CSD which never had them.

step_6 outputs {category}_feature_matrix.parquet, {category}_series_index.csv, {category}_split_dates.json into _03_engineered/bymonth/{CATEGORY}/.

Verify: split ratios land near 70/15/15 for all four (F29 projection: CSD 32/7/7, Danskvand 29/6/6, Energidrikke 30/6/7, RTD 29/6/6).
